bible.title: Tollgate Meridian
bible.premise: A customs post on the Meridian line where the salt trains crossed from the Flats into Carrow.
bible.collapse: On 3 August Chief Inspector Radu Varga shut Gate 2 on a telegraphed order from Carrow while the 06:10 salt train was half through. 14 wagons and 61 passengers stayed on the Flats side. No order to reopen came, and Varga would not act without one.

people.name: Radu Varga
people.want: a written order for everything he does

people.name: Nika Sorrell
people.job: smuggler trading as a tea seller

people.name: Benedek Asztalos
people.want: the 06:10 to run on time once more before he retires

events.fact: Varga seized 40 kilos of tea and one kettle from Sorrell on receipt 0771.
Gate 2 came down across the 06:10 between wagons 8 and 9.
Asztalos set lever 7 to danger and logged the 06:10 as delayed.
Water on the Flats side ran out. Varga issued 1 litre per handwritten receipt.
Sorrell began moving passengers through the Seizure Shed, 2 a night, 22 in all.
Asztalos logged the 06:10 as delayed for the 30th day.
Varga stamped every wagon, passenger and member of staff HELD PENDING ORDERS.

authors.name: Radu Varga
authors.register: Receipt number, date, item, weight, regulation cited. Records other people's reactions as facts. Signs everything.

authors.name: Nika Sorrell
authors.register: Warm, quick, practical. Prices and quantities. Jokes at the inspector's expense. Signs N.

authors.name: Benedek Asztalos
authors.document: pencil notes on the working timetable
authors.register: Times to the minute, lever numbers, wagon counts. Grumbles about punctuality. 41 years in the box.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.title: Seizure receipt 0771
exemplars.source: top copy in the receipt book, Seizure Shed
exemplars.text: Receipt 0771, 12 July. Seized from N. Sorrell, tea seller: tea, 40 kilos, undeclared, Reg. 14(b). Also one kettle, held as evidence of intent to brew. Owner informed of her right to appeal in Carrow. Owner laughed. R. Varga, Chief Inspector.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.title: Letter to Jori, unsent
exemplars.source: folded inside a tea tin, Platform 1
exemplars.text: Jori, I am fine, stop asking the drivers. The gate is shut with half the 06:10 on the wrong side and the inspector won't open it without a letter from Carrow. So I take two a night through his Seizure Shed, past my own tea. I charge them nothing. Don't tell anyone, it's bad for prices. N.

exemplars.author: Benedek Asztalos
exemplars.title: Working timetable, 1 Sept
exemplars.source: pencil in the margin, Signal Box
exemplars.text: 06:10 salt train: DELAYED. Day 30. Lever 7 at danger. For the record it left the Flats on time. It is my end that is late, by 8 wagons.

exemplars.author: Benedek Asztalos
exemplars.title: Working timetable, 3 Aug
exemplars.text: 3 Aug. 06:14, Gate 2 came down between wagons 8 and 9 and I set lever 7 to danger. Forty-one years in this box and the first train I ever stopped was already stopped.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.title: Inventory of held items
exemplars.source: last used page of the receipt book
exemplars.text: Inventory, 14 Sept. Stamped HELD PENDING ORDERS: wagons 9 to 22, 61 passengers less 22 unaccounted, 3 guards, 1 signal operator, 1 kettle. Stamped last: R. Varga. The Carrow stamp is low on ink. I have requested more in writing.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.title: Letter to Jori, 10 Aug
exemplars.source: tucked in the lining of a tea chest
exemplars.text: Jori, water on the Flats side ran out on the 9th. Varga is handing it out against receipts, one litre a receipt, and he writes every receipt himself. Slowly. I have sold him a pen.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.title: Held passenger's ticket
exemplars.source: a card ticket, stamped across the face
exemplars.text: Ticket for wagon 14, the 06:10, Flats to Carrow, single. Punched once on 3 August. Across the face, in purple: HELD PENDING ORDERS. The stamp is Varga's and so is the handwriting on the water receipt folded behind it.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.title: Guard's whistle
exemplars.source: brass whistle on a broken chain
exemplars.text: Gate 2 guard, brass whistle, cap badge 3. Varga posted three guards on 3 August with orders to admit nobody without an order. They asked him who could sign one. He said Carrow.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.title: Runner's lantern
exemplars.source: a tin lantern, three panes blacked
exemplars.text: A shuttered lantern with the glass painted black on three sides. Sorrell's runners used them in the Seizure Shed, two passengers a night. This one has 0771 scratched on the base, which is her tea.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.title: The Carrow stamp
exemplars.source: a brass hand stamp, pad dry
exemplars.text: Brass, 2 kilos, handle worn to the shape of Varga's hand. The pad is dry. His last entry in the receipt book is an order to himself to reopen Gate 2, unsigned, since he had no authority to sign it.
Wagon 9 lies across the track under Gate 2. Guards fire from behind its wheels.
Seizure Shed: tea chests stacked 3 high make two lanes. Runners wait in the left one.
Platform 1. Held passengers queue at a shut window. The signal lamp overhead is live and sparking.

exemplars.author: Benedek Asztalos
exemplars.name: Lever 7
exemplars.text: Benedek Asztalos held it at danger for 30 days. He oiled it every morning anyway.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.name: Receipt 0771
exemplars.text: Varga wrote it for 40 kilos of Sorrell's tea. She kept the copy and quotes it at him.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.name: Two a Night
exemplars.text: Nika Sorrell walked 22 passengers through the Seizure Shed with the lamps out. Nobody tripped.

exemplars.author: Nika Sorrell
exemplars.name: Sorrell's Tea, 100 g
exemplars.text: Restores 25 Integrity over 5 s. Technically evidence. Brew it in anything but Varga's kettle.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.name: Inspector's Whistle
exemplars.text: Stuns enemies within 120 for 1 s. Three blasts meant 'gate closing'. Varga only needed it once.

exemplars.author: Radu Varga
exemplars.name: Water Receipt
exemplars.text: Trade at any hatch for 1 litre: +15 Integrity. Handwritten, numbered, and countersigned by the man who wrote it.

exemplars.name: Gate 2
exemplars.text: A steel gate shut across a train. Wagon 8 is in Carrow, wagon 9 is not.

exemplars.name: Seizure Shed
exemplars.text: Forty kilos of tea, 300 confiscated umbrellas, one unlit path through.

exemplars.name: Signal Box
exemplars.text: Twelve levers, one kettle. Asztalos kept lever 7 at danger and the floor swept.
GATE 2 DROPPING. CLEAR THE TRACK.
VARGA STAMPS THE FLOOR: MOVE OFF THE PURPLE
WHISTLE, 3 BLASTS: GUARDS INCOMING
